# ymfm

Yamaha FM sound chip emulation by Aaron Giles, used for the OPL2 (YM3812)
that the AdLib card is built around.

* Source: https://github.com/aaronsgiles/ymfm
* Revision: 81aec25ccbb98f4873a255f7551ac4dadac59b4a
* License: BSD-3-Clause (see LICENSE)

Only the files needed for the OPL family are included, unmodified.
